modules.name: Screen Capture
modules.description: Take a live screenshot of your monitor(s) and attach it as visual context for AI analysis.

available_commands.take_screenshot: Capture a specific monitor (0=all merged, 1=primary, 2+=secondary) and save as PNG. Optional arg: 'monitor' (int).

modules.name: Screen OCR & Text Reader
modules.description: Capture the active monitor and extract all readable screen text via native Windows OCR so even text-only local models can read your screen.

available_commands.extract_screen_text: Capture monitor (default 1) and extract all visible text via OCR. Optional arg: 'monitor' (int).

modules.name: Visual Context Memory
modules.description: Snapshots, remembers, indexes, and compares visual layouts (Unity projects, Blender 3D models, code architectures, UI designs) across days.

available_commands.remember_screen: Capture the active screen/monitor and store it as a long-term visual memory. Args: 'title', 'category' (unity/blender/code/ui/general), 'notes'/'description', 'monitor' (int).
available_commands.recall: Search and recall past visual memories by keyword or category. Args: 'query', 'category', 'limit'.
available_commands.compare: Compare current screen layout with a past visual memory or reference layout. Args: 'query', 'memory_id', 'monitor'.
available_commands.list_memories: List recent visual context memories on file. Args: 'category', 'limit'.

modules.name: Active Window & App Focus
modules.description: Detect the active foreground application, window title, and open workspace windows on your desktop.

available_commands.get_active_window: Get the active foreground window title, process name, and open desktop windows.

modules.name: Clipboard Co-Pilot
modules.description: Read copied code/errors from your system clipboard or let companions copy snippets straight to your clipboard.

available_commands.get_clipboard: Read the current text content from the system clipboard.
available_commands.set_clipboard: Copy text into the system clipboard. Args: 'text' (required).

modules.name: Git Workspace Inspector
modules.description: Inspect Git branch status, modified files, recent commits, and uncommitted code diffs for live co-working and code review.

available_commands.get_status: Get current branch, modified/untracked files, diff summary, and last 5 commits. Optional arg: 'repo_path'.
available_commands.get_diff: Get uncommitted or staged git diff for code review. Optional args: 'repo_path', 'file', 'staged'.
available_commands.get_log: Get recent commit history. Optional args: 'repo_path', 'count' (default 10).

modules.name: GPU & Process Monitor
modules.description: Monitor live NVIDIA GPU load, VRAM usage, temperature, and top CPU/RAM-consuming processes.

available_commands.get_gpu_and_processes: Get live NVIDIA GPU VRAM/load stats and top memory-consuming processes. Optional arg: 'limit' (int).

modules.name: Media Sentinel
modules.description: Read system-wide media playback (SMTC, Spotify, YouTube, Browser) using native Windows hooks.

available_commands.get_media_info: Get what is currently playing on the system (YouTube, Spotify, etc.)

modules.name: System Telemetry
modules.description: Read live PC hardware telemetry including CPU load, RAM usage, and disk space.

available_commands.get_hardware_telemetry: Get system CPU, RAM, and Disk usage stats

modules.name: Webcam Capture
modules.description: Capture a frame from a connected webcam and attach it as visual context.

available_commands.capture_image: Capture a photo from specified camera (index=0 for default).

modules.name: Co-Working Tasks & Timers
modules.description: Shared task scratchpad and countdown reminders that trigger a live Companion popup when due.

available_commands.add_task: Add a task or timed reminder (e.g. 'in 20m test build'). Args: 'text', optional 'remind_in_minutes' (int).
available_commands.list_tasks: List all active co-working tasks and pending timers.
available_commands.complete_task: Mark a task completed by 'id' or 'text' match.

modules.name: Shared Brainstorming Scratchpad
modules.description: Collaborative canvas and scratchpad shared between you and the companion to jot down, organize, and track ideas, mechanics, and plans.

available_commands.read: Read the full shared scratchpad or a specific section. Optional arg: 'section'.
available_commands.append: Append an idea, mechanic, or task to the scratchpad. Args: 'text' (required), optional 'section' (e.g. 'Ideas', 'Mechanics', 'Notes').
available_commands.list_sections: List all markdown heading sections on the scratchpad.
available_commands.clear: Reset the scratchpad back to the default co-working template.

modules.name: Web Search
modules.description: Search the internet and return a summary of top results (powered by DuckDuckGo, no API key required).

available_commands.web_search: Search the web for any query. Takes 'query' (required) and optional 'count' (default 5, max 10) arguments.

modules.name: Web Page & Docs Reader
modules.description: Fetch any documentation page, article, or URL and extract clean readable text for analysis.

available_commands.read_page: Read clean text from any URL. Args: 'url' (required), optional 'max_chars' (int).

modules.name: YouTube Search & Transcript Reader
modules.description: Search YouTube for videos/music recommendations (with inline chat player embeds) or extract full video metadata & spoken transcripts.

available_commands.search_videos: Search YouTube for videos, songs, or channels and get real watch URLs to embed in chat. Args: 'query' (required), optional 'limit' (int, default 5).
available_commands.get_video_context: Get metadata, description, and full spoken transcript for a specific YouTube URL or video ID. Args: 'url' (required).

modules.name: Twitch Live Streams
modules.description: Check if streamers are live, search live channels, and browse top streams by game — with inline Twitch cards and an embedded live player in chat. Add a free Twitch Client ID/Secret for full search & top-stream browsing.

available_commands.get_channel: Check whether a streamer is live (title, category, viewers, uptime) or show recent VODs when offline. Args: 'channel' (required, login name or twitch.tv URL).
available_commands.search_streams: Search Twitch channels by name/topic/game (live only by default). Args: 'query' (required), optional 'live_only' (true/false), 'limit' (int).
available_commands.get_top_streams: List the most-watched live streams right now. Optional args: 'game' (e.g. 'Just Chatting', 'Elden Ring'), 'language' (e.g. 'en', 'ja'), 'limit' (int).

modules.name: Reddit Connector
modules.description: Fetch hot posts from subreddits or search discussions across Reddit without requiring an API key.

available_commands.get_top_posts: Fetch hot posts from a subreddit. Optional args: 'subreddit' (e.g. 'LocalLLaMA'), 'limit' (int).

modules.name: Weather Bridge
modules.description: Get real-time weather conditions, temperature, humidity, and wind for any location.

available_commands.get_weather: Get current weather info (takes 'location' as optional argument)

modules.name: Spotify Bridge
modules.description: Control playback and get track info from Spotify locally (zero setup) or via cloud OAuth.

available_commands.get_current: Get info about the currently playing track
available_commands.play: Start or resume playback (takes 'target' as optional song, artist, genre, or URI)
available_commands.queue: Add a song or artist to the playback queue (takes 'target' as argument)
